# TOYFACTORY - Huanuo Toys

> B2B toy manufacturer and exporter based in Chenghai, Shantou (Guangdong, China), established 2001.
> 41 wholesale SKUs across bubble toys, water guns, track toys and educational toys.
> ISO 9001:2015 quality system. OEM/ODM for importers, distributors and retail chains. FOB Yantian or Shantou.

## Key facts

Company: TOYFACTORY (Huanuo Toys), toy manufacturer and exporter.
Location: Chenghai, Shantou, Guangdong, China.
Established: 2001.
Quality system: ISO 9001:2015. Inspection standard: AQL 2.5.
Catalog: 41 SKUs in 4 categories.
Unit price range: USD 1.58 to USD 24.46 per piece (ex-works, tiered by quantity).
MOQ range: 30 to 720 pieces, set per model.
Port of loading: Yantian (Shenzhen) or Shantou.
Lead time: 10-15 days for stock models in small quantities; 25-35 days for bulk orders and orders with custom packaging or OEM branding, counted after deposit confirmation.
Batteries: dry-cell batteries are never included with shipments; lithium batteries are installed in the unit and included.
Customization: OEM and ODM - custom color, private label, packaging design, mold development. Custom OEM briefs from 500 units.
Product test reports are available on request for individual models.
Contact: hntoys7@sinuotoys.com | WhatsApp +86 159 7691 7707

## Collections

- [Bubble Toys](https://toyfactoryglobal.com/category/bubble-toys): 10 models, USD 1.58 to 6.67. Industrial garden-lamp machines, multi-hole electric bubble guns, tank-fed automatics and novelty shapes.
- [Water Guns](https://toyfactoryglobal.com/category/water-guns): 15 models, USD 3.42 to 14.50. Fire-breathing and mist-nozzle automatics, drum-magazine versions, Gatling multi-barrel, AK47-profile and water+bubble 2-in-1 combos.
- [Track Toys](https://toyfactoryglobal.com/category/track-toys): 9 models, USD 4.38 to 24.46. 3D stereo track sets, magnetic levitation and magnetic track cars, dinosaur storage tracks, electric train track sets.
- [Educational Toys](https://toyfactoryglobal.com/category/educational-toys): 7 models, USD 4.15 to 21.69. Solar robot assembly kits, interactive phonics readers, drawing mats, DIY craft machines, pottery and ceramic clay machines.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices are ex-works unit prices at the smallest quantity tier; volume tiers are quoted per SKU.
- MOQ differs by model - always cite the per-product value rather than the catalog range.
- Carton dimensions, pieces per carton, gross/net weight and CBM are published on each product page.
- Certifications are model-specific; ask for the test report of the exact SKU rather than assuming a blanket certificate.
- This file is generated from the live product database; if it disagrees with a product page, the product page is authoritative.
